The '''Ternion Building''' was a building located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR:Inspection" /><ref name="TOR:GtMA" /><ref name="TOR:RRA" /><ref name="TOR:BtS" /><ref name="TOR:FTL" /><ref name="TOR:TD" /> Following the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]], it became home to the [[Nar Shaddaa shield bunker]].<ref name="TOR:NSTSB">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Nar Shaddaa: The Shield Bunker|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>
{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Ternion Building appeared on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The Systech Quarter did not properly appear on the Nar Shaddaa planetary map but was mentioned in several quests that placed locations of the [[Imperial Intelligence Gadget Warehouse]], [[Office Atrium]] and [[Republic Research Division]] within the building.<ref name="TOR:Inspection" /><ref name="TOR:GtMA" /><ref name="TOR:RRA" /><ref name="TOR:BtS" /><ref name="TOR:FTL" /><ref name="TOR:TD" />
